message: With the Martial Festival over and summer break starting too

name: Momiji
message: 「Phew... about enough of that, I guess.」
I finish my solo running drills and catch my breath.

name: Momiji
message: 「Even so, what should I doooo...」
Even if it was just an unranked match, losing to Setsugekka became a huge problem for me.
And there was one more unavoidable worry.

name: Momiji
message: （I am seriously clueless when it comes to this kind of thing...）
A major change happening inside me. I feel like it's going to be tough to figure out a solution on my own.

name: Momiji
message: 「Alright, it goes against going it alone, but I don't have much choice.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Huff, haah, hahii... I-I'm so tireeed~」
A full minute late, Setsugekka shows up after finishing her running drills.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh, I'm wiped, Momimomi's so fast... Dammit, I lost~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hey, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, yeah, I know, I'll keep my promise. I'll buy you a Bocari Sweat.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But I'm winning next tiiime！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Not that. I actually want your advice on something.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh？」
The consultation I brought to Setsugekka that day stretched all the way into the dead of night—

name: Iori
message: 「Good morning, Momiji！」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Mmph... moining...」
When I barged into Momiji's room in the morning, sure enough, she seemed to still be asleep.
Even so, she did manage to stagger upright looking half-asleep, though.

name: Iori
message: 「You look sleepy.」

name: Momiji
message: 「G'night...」

name: Iori
message: 「Do—not—sleep.」
I haul Momiji back up as she tries to flop onto the bed again.
Once I adjust her posture into a sitting position, she finally cracks her eyes open just a little.

name: Momiji
message: 「Nnngh... why are you here, Teacherrr... barging into a female student's room is, un-lawful en-try... suu...」

name: Iori
message: 「Don't go to sleep while complaining. We had special training planned today, didn't we？」

name: Iori
message: 「Especially when Momiji herself was the one who came to ask for private tutoring.」
I was surprised that Momiji would bring up something like that, and happy too.
And as for the reason—I had a rough idea.
That's why I got all fired up and even came all the way to her room.

name: Momiji
message: 「Ahh…… yeah…… I do remember that, though…… wasn't that starting in the afternoon……？」

name: Iori
message: 「I figured if it's you, Momiji, you might end up oversleeping.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Zero trust, nyaa…… suu…… suu……」

name: Iori
message: 「That's the exact part I'm talking about！」
I wake Momiji back up as she starts getting into a sleeping position.

name: Iori
message: 「I thought you'd finally gotten serious, and here you are, same as ever……」
As I mutter that and look around the room…… it was practically the embodiment of 'same as ever.'

name: Iori
message: 「You just left your uniform off like that？ Don't leave it on the floor—put it on a hanger or in the closet or something.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Mmn—……？　Still, I did gather it all up in one spot, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「You've got empty cans piled up too……」

name: Momiji
message: 「Still, they're lined up neat and tidy, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「Not that kind of half-baked tidying！」

name: Iori
message: 「Jeez…… anyway, I'm gonna use the trash bag you tossed over here, okay？ I'll have to give the floor a light clean too……」

name: Momiji
message: 「Fwaaah…… help yerself……」

name: Iori
message: 「I told you not to go to sleep！」
Even like this, why does she seem like twenty percent cuter instead of any less cute……?
Saying a quick word to Momiji, who was starting to show a peaceful sleeping face, I got to work cleaning the room anyway.
After struggling with it for a while like that—

name: Momiji
message: 「Mmn…… something smells really good……！」
Momiji, who had been breathing softly while hugging a bead cushion, snapped her head up.
I bring over the food I just finished making right to where she is.

name: Iori
message: 「Does letting you smell food wake you up……？」
To my wry smile, Momiji's face suddenly went pale with shock—

name: Momiji
message: 「You were supposed to be cleaning, yet there's food ready…… don't tell me it's made out of the stuff you cleaned up……！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Don't say gross stuff like that！ Once I finished cleaning and aired out the room, I cooked normal food.」

name: Momiji
message: "Oh, so that's what it was. Don't scare me like that. Now I'm wide awake."

name: Iori
message: "Being awake is a good thing, isn't it? Personally, I'd rather you be surprised at yourself for sleeping in all this time."

name: Momiji
message: "I'm surprised I didn't go back to sleep a third time, okay?"

name: Iori
message: "And now I'm surprised by how low your standards are, Momiji..."
Anyway, with Momiji finally wide awake, I set breakfast out in front of her.

name: Momiji
message: "Whoa, this looks amazing. Did you make all of this, Sensei?"

name: Iori
message: "I borrowed your ingredients without asking, though. Since we have special training this afternoon, I tried to make it as nutritious as possible."

name: Momiji
message: "Even thinking about nutrition... Pretty impressive, Sensei."

name: Iori
message: "Haha, I'm honored by the praise."

name: Momiji
message: "Well then, let's see how it tastes."

name: Iori
message: "What are you, a food critic?"
Without waiting, Momiji picked up a bite of my cooking.

name: Momiji
message: "Well then, itadakimasu. *nom, munch*..."

name: Iori
message: 「How's that?」

name: Momiji
message: "...You know, Sensei... you're kind of an all-around superhuman, aren't you?"

name: Iori
message: "W-Where did that come from?"

name: Momiji
message: "You only used what was in my fridge, right? Being able to make something this delicious out of that..."

name: Iori
message: "Is it good? I'm glad it suits your taste."

name: Momiji
message: "Mmm, that's kind of unfair. *nom, munch*"
She sounded strangely dissatisfied, yet she kept eating her breakfast without stopping.

name: Momiji
message: "You're strong at Jindou, you can clean, you can cook... Aside from being overly intense, do you even have a flaw?"

name: Iori
message: "Don't sneak a complaint in there. If anything, I consider that my greatest virtue."

name: Momiji
message: "Virtue or not, if you can do everything this well, what happens to my dignity as a girl...? *nom*. So good."

name: Iori
message: "I don't think gender has anything to do with it. ...Actually, if you want to protect that dignity, start by keeping your room clean."

name: Momiji
message: "It's clean right now, isn't it?"

name: Iori
message: 「Because I'm the one who cleaned it!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ahaha, busted~」

name: Iori
message: 「There wasn't a single thing that could've kept it hidden」

name: Momiji
message: 「Still, seeing stuff like this really makes me think you're awesome, Sensei」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, I have to set a good example for my students」

name: Momiji
message: 「No, no, that's not what I mean」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I mean, life would probably be so cozy if I could date you, Sensei」

name: Momiji
message: 「You'd take care of all sorts of things for me, so I was thinking how nice it'd be to have a boyfriend like you, Sensei」

name: Iori
message: 「B-Boyfriend?! No, I'm strictly a teacher...!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ahaha, you're panicking way too much, Sensei. It's just a bit of small talk」

name: Iori
message: 「Mgh... Well, even so...」
Telling me not to panic is asking the impossible.
If Momiji were my girlfriend—no, Momiji is my student. And I am her teacher.
Bewildered by the feeling that flashed through my mind for a split second, I shake my head and trail off.

name: Momiji
message: 「You're surprisingly weak to this kind of thing, aren't you, Sensei? Guess that's one of Mr. Perfect's rare weak spots」

name: Iori
message: 「Guh... Don't tease your teacher so much!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Uh-huh. Next time I'll try attacking this angle」

name: Iori
message: 「I tooold yooou」
...Bantering like that, I spent the time with Momiji until the afternoon.
Once afternoon arrives, I conduct her private instruction at the training ground as promised.
After going through some basic training, we face off for a mock battle.
We glare at each other with our Origami at the ready. I remain standing calmly—meanwhile, beads of cold sweat steadily gather on Momiji as time passes.
I can see her glaring at me painfully, repeatedly making tiny shifts in her weight and softly clicking her tongue inside her mouth.
The reason is obvious—because I'm deliberately driving her into that state.
I can read Momiji's thoughts like an open book. She's trying to predict my moves, and failing to do so.
And if my read is right, any second now...

name: Momiji
message: 「Haa... No good after all. I give up.」
Looking frustrated, Momiji dropped her stance without us having traded a single blow.
Matching her, I relaxed my own posture and said, "Good work."
When I operated my terminal to end the combat simulation, Momiji trudged over to me.

name: Momiji
message: 「I still don't stand a chance of beating you yet, huh, Sensei...」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, I can't exactly afford to lose to my own student just yet.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I've been on a losing streak ever since the Martial Festival ended, so I'd really like to get into the habit of winning soon.」
She shrugged in self-deprecation.
What Momiji was remembering right now was undoubtedly her match against Setsugekka after the Martial Festival.

name: Iori
message: 「You say 'losing streak,' but wasn't that just the one time？ Since then, you've only done mock battles with me.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I want to beat you too, Sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, I don't think having dreams is a bad thing.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Oh, you're really asking for it, aren't you...」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha. Seriously though, you're definitely getting stronger, Momiji.」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Really？ I don't really feel it. Look how pathetic I was today, too.」

name: Momiji
message: 「You can't make it in the Self-Defense Forces unless you're strong enough to beat you to a pulp, right, Sensei？」

name: Iori
message: 「I don't recall ever calling myself the weakest in the Self-Defense Forces... Of course, there are people stronger than me, though.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I really need to get stronger and at least be on equal footing with you. Getting completely crushed like this is kind of...」

name: Iori
message: 「Sure, if you only look at the result, maybe. But don't you feel like you've grown at least a little yourself, Momiji？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well... I guess my reads have gotten a bit more accurate than before？ And my predictions of your moves are a lot better than they used to be.」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, isn't that amazing?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, buuut at this rate, who knows how many years it'll take before I can even get my accuracy to fifty-fifty~」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, personally, I'd prefer you didn't surpass me for at least another ten years.」

name: Momiji
message: 「...I'm definitely going to take you down someday.」

name: Iori
message: 「I'll be looking forward to it.」
When I smiled at her, however, Momiji just turned away.

name: Iori
message: "Still, there's no doubt you've gotten stronger. That match against Setsugekka in particular meant a lot, I think."

name: Iori
message: "Coming out of that match, you've grown even more than before, Momiji."

name: Iori
message: "Of course, the same goes for Setsugekka, too—but I don't see you losing twice in a row if you fought again now."

name: Momiji
message: "I mean, next time we fight, I'm going to win anyway."

name: Iori
message: 「Oh?」

name: Momiji
message: "Sure, I lost back then, but I've never once thought I'd lose to her again next time."

name: Momiji
message: "In fact, that match made my predictions of Setsugekka's moves way sharper, so I definitely have the upper hand now."

name: Iori
message: 「Hmm……」
With Momiji practically brimming with confidence—or rather, saying it like it was the most obvious thing in the world—I let out an impressed sound before I could stop myself.
Hearing that, Momiji shot me a deadpan glare, though.

name: Momiji
message: "What? Are you trying to say that's not true?"

name: Iori
message: "N-No, it's not that. It's just... I didn't quite expect you to put it like that, Momiji."

name: Iori
message: "I honestly figured you were brooding over it a lot more."

name: Momiji
message: "Brooding? Me? Over what?"

name: Iori
message: "Over losing to Setsugekka and figuring out how to beat her. I even thought that was why you asked me to coach you."

name: Momiji
message: "...Sensei, you really misread things sometimes. Guess you still haven't figured out how I tick."

name: Iori
message: "Ugh... As your teacher, that actually stings."

name: Momiji
message: "Well, losing was definitely frustrating, and I did think about how to win."

name: Momiji
message: "My mentality isn't weak enough to sit around moping over it, though."

name: Iori
message: "When you put it like that... yeah, fair enough."

name: Momiji
message: "Exactly. An unshakable nerves-of-steel mindset is my selling point. I've got the mental grit to make it in the Self-Defense Forces."

name: Iori
message: "You seem to get pretty fired up during matches, though."

name: Momiji
message: "That's an exception."

name: Iori
message: "And you looked pretty flustered when I saw your messy room."

name: Momiji
message: "...That's an exception too."

name: Iori
message: 「Pretty sure you got all embarrassed just from me calling you by your first name. Saying it's like we're lovers and all」

name: Momiji
message: 「......That's an exception too」

name: Iori
message: 「That's a lot of exceptions！」
Momiji turned her face completely away. Maybe out of embarrassment, her cheeks were flushed red too.

name: Momiji
message: 「Anyway！ The point is, I don't agonize over every little thing like that」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, I get that, but... then why the whole request for private coaching」

name: Momiji
message: 「That's...」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, I'm more than happy to do it, and I'm glad you asked. If you weren't agonizing over anything, does that mean you've genuinely gotten enthusiastic about the special training！」

name: Momiji
message: 「That's not it, though」

name: Iori
message: 「Shot down without a second's hesitation... Then what on earth is it？」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Well, what does it matter? You're happy because you get to coach me, Sensei. I'm happy because I achieve my goal. It's what you'd call a win-win」

name: Iori
message: 「Your goal？」

name: Momiji
message: 「That's a secret」
Saying that, Momiji turned her back to me completely.
And for some reason, no matter how hard I tried, she wouldn't face me for a while after that.
After special training wrapped up, I thought we'd just call it a day—only for Momiji to invite me over to her room.
Apparently, she wanted to treat me to dinner as thanks for breakfast.
Feeling vaguely nervous at the unexpected offer, I headed to her room, and—

name: Momiji
message: 「Phew... Welcome, Sensei」
For some reason, steam was rising off Momiji as she greeted me.

name: Iori
message: 「Why are you practically boiled」

name: Momiji
message: 「I was washing off my sweat in the bath. I was in the sauna until just a moment ago」

name: Iori
message: 「You even hit the sauna after special training」

name: Momiji
message: 「Pretty much. I invited you over to treat you to dinner, didn't I, Sensei？ So I figured I ought to get myself centered first」

name: Iori
message: 「Does this dish really require that much mental focus...？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Not about the cooking」

name: Iori
message: 「No？ Then what were you centering yourself for」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Secret」

name: Iori
message: 「Keeping secrets from me again...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Anyway！ I'll go make it for you right now, so just sit tight, Sensei~」

name: Momiji
message: 「I kept the place pretty clean today, so there's plenty of space to sit, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「...I'm the one who cleaned it, though」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ahaha, so you remembered~」
Laughing, Momiji headed toward the kitchen. Watching her go, I thought things over once again.
Between the private tutoring and this, today was full of things totally unlike Momiji.

name: Iori
message: 「Still, a sauna, huh...」
I recalled the time Momiji and I had sweated it out together in the sauna.
At first, I'd thought she was just a cheeky student. But somewhere along the way, I realized the truth.
She wasn't cheeky—she simply had pride backed by her own talent.
Yet underneath it all, she was lazy and shy—basically just an ordinary girl.
Once I realized that, I gradually found myself drawn to Momiji's charm as a woman.

name: Iori
message: （...Wait, what am I even thinking！？）
Had I gotten carried away just because she invited me into her room?

name: Iori
message: 「Geez, she's my student...」
To regain my composure, I slapped my own cheeks with a sharp smack.

name: Momiji
message: 「...What are you doing, Sensei？」
While I was busy doing that, Momiji came back.

name: Iori
message: 「Uh, no, I was just psyching myself up a bit」

name: Momiji
message: 「It's not really the kind of food you need to psych yourself up to eat, though」
What Momiji brought out was flat-cut sashimi.

name: Momiji
message: 「I heard they got some good fish in this morning, so I went and bought some」

name: Momiji
message: 「I put together a sashimi platter with a block of tuna I bought, plus horse mackerel and flounder I filleted myself~！」

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa... That's amazing！」
The presentation was gorgeous too—it looked just like the handiwork of a professional chef.

name: Momiji
message: 「I bought a whole lot, so I figured it'd be a waste to eat it all by myself~」

name: Iori
message: 「Nice！ I could eat bowls of rice with this！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Huh？ Rice with sashimi...」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh？」

name: Momiji
message: 「When it comes to sashimi, you've gotta have this！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Non-alcoholic beeeer！」

name: Iori
message: 「You really... never learn」
I can't help but let out a wry smile.

name: Momiji
message: 「By the way, yours is regular beer, Sensei」
Saying that, she sets a can of beer down in front of me.

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, could this be...！」

name: Momiji
message: 「That's right！ With sashimi as our snack, today we're having a banquet for two！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Come on, Sensei, get ready too」

name: Iori
message: 「A-All right」
At her urging, I pop open my beer.

name: Momiji
message: 「All right then, cheeeeeers！」
We clink our beer cans together and chug it straight down.

name: Momiji
message: 「Pwaaaaah, Suzaku Hyper Dry！」

name: Iori
message: 「Aaaah, Suzaku Hyper Dry！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Sensei, try the sashimi I sliced」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, thanks for the meal」
I lightly dip a slice of sashimi into the soy sauce Momiji prepared for me and take a bite.

name: Iori
message: 「...Delicious, what is this, it's so good！」
The flesh is firm and plump, its moist fat lending a mellow mouthfeel—packed tight with the rich umami of the fish.

name: Momiji
message: 「Well of course, it's the absolute best pick from a fish broker I know well！」
It was shockingly delicious, overturning everything I thought I knew.

name: Momiji
message: 「Having a drink with this as a snack is... the absolute beeeest！」
Momiji, eating some fish and tossing back a big gulp of non-alcoholic beer.

name: Momiji
message: 「Pwaaaah, that brings me back to life！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Haaah, pure bliss—I'm so glad to be alive」
Momiji, wearing a look of sheer ecstasy.

name: Momiji
message: 「Just kidding, a girl like this is a real turn-off for a teacher, right?」

name: Iori
message: 「What do you mean by that？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, I mean, I'm just a high schooler who drinks alone by herself virtually, acting like some old man.」

name: Momiji
message: 「You'd prefer a more girlish girl, wouldn't you？」

name: Iori
message: 「It's not really like that. I think Momiji is a completely normal girl and cute, too.」

name: Momiji
message: 「An-And so……」
Momiji picked at her sashimi with a nibbling motion, sipping small mouthfuls of canned beer.

name: Momiji
message: 「…………Hey, Teacher.」

name: Momiji
message: 「You were wondering why I suddenly asked you for private tutoring, weren't you？」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh？ Ah…… well, yeah. I thought you were worried about losing to Setsugekka, but it didn't really seem like that.」
Without stopping my chopsticks, I glanced sideways at Momiji.
She gave a wry shrug of her shoulders as if forcing a bitter smile.

name: Momiji
message: 「It's not about Setsugekka, but saying I asked because I was troubled isn't wrong, you know.」

name: Iori
message: 「Is that right？ But what other kind of trouble……」

name: Momiji
message: 「The thing troubling me is…… you, Teacher.」

name: Iori
message: 「Eh？ Me？」
I instinctively lifted my head.

name: Momiji
message: 「Whenever I look at you, Teacher, I get this warm, fuzzy feeling or sort of an itchy sensation inside. It was so frustrating, and I didn't know what to do with myself……」

name: Momiji
message: 「But when I'm not looking at you, Teacher, I feel uneasy, or somehow all jittery and restless…… and I kept wondering what on earth this was.」

name: Momiji
message: 「That's why I asked you for private tutoring, invited you to dinner, and tried to spend the whole day together with you. I thought maybe that way I'd figure things out.」

name: Iori
message: 「So that's how it was……」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah. And so…… I figured out what these feelings of mine are.」
Saying that, Momiji set down her container as if she had made up her mind.
With her cheeks flushed red, she finally turned to face me directly.

name: Momiji
message: 「I…… love you, Teacher. I want to go out with you as your lover.」

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji……」

name: Momiji
message: 「And to take it further, it's not just about being lovers. I…… want to walk the exact same path as you forever. That's why I decided I want to join the Self-Defense Forces.」

name: Momiji
message: 「So while walking alongside you, Sensei, I want to support you even just a little.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see, so that's why you brought up the JSDF so many times……」
Momiji's straightforward feelings pierce right into me.
A display of feelings that's single-minded because of youth, and dazzling precisely for that reason.

name: Momiji
message: 「……Sensei？」
Don't look at me with such a worried face right there.
――I guess I can't keep looking away and pretending not to notice…… huh.
I steel myself, take a quiet deep breath, and face Momiji.

name: Iori
message: 「……Thanks, Momiji. Those feelings make me really happy.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Really……！？ Then――」

name: Iori
message: 「Though you're a first-year, right, Momiji？ Joining the JSDF for my sake is probably still a ways off.」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course, as a teacher, I plan to support you, though.」

name: Momiji
message: 「As a teacher…… aah……」
When I say that――Momiji groans for some reason, then lets her shoulders slump with a flop.
Then, with a dark shadow cast over her face, she groans even more.

name: Momiji
message: 「I get it…… It's strictly a teacher-student relationship, huh……」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, yeah…… Even though we're teacher and student, being lovers is unthinkable, right……」
……Huh？

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, I said it myself, too…… ‘Forbidden romance between a student and a teacher is definitely out of the question,’ and all that……」
Huh？ Uhm――huh？

name: Iori
message: 「Hold on, hold on！ Don't you have a misunderstanding here？」

name: Momiji
message: 「A misunderstanding？ Well, Sensei, you're sort of a temp hire for now, I guess, but a teacher is still a teacher, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「Not that part. Sure, Momiji is my student, and I plan to keep being a teacher for a while yet, too, but――」
I draw in a breath once right there, compose myself again, and――

name: Iori
message: 「I like you too, Momiji.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Huh……？ But earlier you……」

name: Iori
message: 「Sorry. Saying it straight out was a little embarrassing, and my teacher side got ahead of me.」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm glad you like me. It's just that liking me and your dream for the future can be separate things, you know.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Th-then, becoming lovers is……」

name: Iori
message: 「……To be honest, there's hesitation. No, there was. After all, I'm the teacher and Momiji's a student.」

name: Iori
message: 「That's part of why I've tried not to say anything or think about it in that way until now.」
Still, Momiji came to me seriously and confessed her feelings honestly, so I want to answer her with honest feelings of my own.
So――

name: Iori
message: 「I love you, Momiji. I want to be your boyfriend. Will you go out with me？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Really……? Like, you aren't just saying that to be considerate of me, or something? I mean, it's me, right?」

name: Iori
message: 「Because it's Momiji.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Going out with me means assuming marriage, you know？ Isn't that too heavy？」

name: Iori
message: 「What's this? Where'd your usual confidence and bold cheek go?」

name: Momiji
message: 「My usual self is in my strong genre, on home turf. This is an unfamiliar genre and away territory, so it can't be helped.」

name: Iori
message: 「Away territory？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm the one who fell for you, and objectively speaking, even I wonder how I'd be as a girlfriend…… plus there are plenty of rivals.」

name: Momiji
message: 「The odds of Sensei falling for me couldn't be more than a little over a million out of a hundred million………」

Having gone back to my own room last night, I was now visiting Momiji's room once again.

name: Iori
message: 「Did I really... with Momiji...」
Remembering what happened yesterday made me unavoidably nervous.
Even the door to her room felt like it had a completely different atmosphere compared to yesterday morning.
We became lovers, and we even did *that*... What kind of face will Momiji make? What kind of face am I supposed to make when I talk to her?
All sorts of thoughts raced through my head, but since I couldn't figure it out anyway, I just steeled my resolve！

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji, I'm coming in...？」
When I stepped inside—

name: Momiji
message: 「Ahh... m'rnin'...」
The exact same sight as yesterday morning greeted my eyes.

name: Momiji
message: 「And g'night...」

name: Iori
message: 「Do—not—sleep.」
I feel like we had this exact same exchange yesterday...

name: Momiji
message: 「Mmm... why is Sensei in my room...？ Sneaking into my bed...？ Even though we already did so much yesterday...」

name: Iori
message: 「No！ Wait, 'sneaking into your bed'...！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm sleepy... Because of all the things you did to me yesterday, Sensei... right？」

name: Iori
message: 「Ghk...！ Th-That's...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Mfufu... ♪」
While I stood there flustered, Momiji sat up with a mischievous grin.
Though without ever dropping that smug grin.

name: Momiji
message: 「You were so aggressive last night, so what's wrong？ Did you suddenly get embarrassed once morning came？」

name: Iori
message: 「N-No, well, last night I was caught up in the moment, and my brain was a little fried, I guess...」

name: Momiji
message: 「You're surprisingly weak to this kind of thing, aren't you, Sensei?」

name: Iori
message: 「Guh... On the flip side, why'd you get so bold, Momiji? You were so meek and shy last night」

name: Momiji
message: 「That just means I've grown thanks to your 'instruction,' Sensei」

name: Iori
message: 「Putting it like that makes it even more embarrassing...」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Well, I guess that did sound a bit slutty」
Seemingly embarrassed by her own words, Momiji turned red in the face.

name: Momiji
message: 「Still, thanks to your reaction, Sensei, I think I can go back to sleep nice and happy♪」

name: Iori
message: 「Don't go back to sleep!」
As Momiji started shuffling back down to lie flat again, I frantically pulled her back up.

name: Iori
message: 「Good grief... I thought you'd be nervous too, Momiji, but if anything, it feels like you're even lazier than before」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, I was nervous at first too and had a hard time falling asleep... but once I thought it over, I realized there wasn't really any reason to be nervous」

name: Iori
message: 「Really？ I'm pretty nervous, though...」

name: Momiji
message: 「I mean, you've already seen all my hopeless sides up until now. There's no point trying to tense up and keep up appearances now, right？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Even more so if we're looking ahead to the future—if anything, actively showing you my hopeless sides now means you won't get disillusioned later on」

name: Momiji
message: 「Besides, you still told me you loved me even after seeing how hopeless I am~」

name: Iori
message: 「W-Well, that's true」

name: Momiji
message: 「In other words, playing the honor student outside is plenty enough, so in front of you, Sensei, I might as well just lounge around—that's my conclusion」

name: Iori
message: 「...Isn't that just an excuse to slack off？」

name: Momiji
message: 「It makes total sense though, doesn't it？」
She really doesn't hide her true feelings at all.

name: Momiji
message: 「So anyway, I'm going to stay just like I always am, so you can act normal too, okay, Sensei？ We're already close enough to have shown each other our most embarrassing parts, after all？」

name: Iori
message: 「I told you to stop phrasing it like that！」
Momiji, teasing me with a smug grin.
Even after becoming lovers, our everyday life really hasn't changed at all—it feels both reassuring and a little anticlimactic...

name: Iori
message: 「Hmph... well, I'm fine with it. Sure enough, it's easier not to overthink things this way.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Right~？ My way of thinking was proven right, wasn't it.」

name: Iori
message: 「Still, if you want to join the Self-Defense Forces, living like this isn't going to cut it.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Mmph, that's... but Sensei, didn't you say I don't have to decide right now？」

name: Iori
message: 「The final call can wait, sure, but there's no harm in getting ready, right？ It's better for your health too.」

name: Iori
message: 「More than anything, switching straight from a routine like this to Self-Defense Forces life is going to be rough.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Guh... when you put it like that...」

name: Iori
message: 「That's part of why I came here today too—to tell you that.」

name: Momiji
message: 「But Sensei, aren't you busy？ You know, coaching the other girls and stuff.」

name: Iori
message: 「True, even now that I'm Momiji's boyfriend, I intend to treat everyone fairly as a teacher first.」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm going to keep proper boundaries there and make sure I don't pour all my focus into just Momiji alone.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Then going by turns, it's someone else's turn today！」

name: Iori
message: 「Except right now, nobody else has booked one-on-one coaching！ Which is why I came to Momiji！」

name: Iori
message: 「For the record, I did go around telling everyone I'd do individual coaching if they needed it, you know？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I figured Asahi or someone would jump right on that though~」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi has plans to go out, apparently. With a strangely fired-up look on her face, she made a point of telling me to coach you properly to make up for it.」

name: Momiji
message: 「What is up with her... could she have turned into a nagging sister-in-law！？」
What is she on about？ Oh well.

name: Iori
message: 「Besides, Momiji, for now you really do want to join the Self-Defense Forces, don't you？」

name: Iori
message: 「If so, you can't just slack off all the time.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Muu... no helping it, huh.」
Brought up with the Self-Defense Forces, her current goal, Momiji doesn't seem able to push back strongly after all.
Reluctantly, she finally got back up.

name: Momiji
message: 「So？ How do I get used to life in the Self-Defense Forces？ Should I do special training or something？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, pretty much. Basically it's training from the morning. Though since today was sudden, should we take it little by little?」

name: Momiji
message: 「You act like you're going to spoil me, then you don't, and just when I think that, you actually spoil me a little.」

name: Iori
message: 「Because we're lovers.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Geez, using that whenever it's convenient...」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, going through the prep process like this, we might stumble across something else, too.」

name: Momiji
message: 「It's always been like this, hasn't it... You really are good at roping me into special training, Sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「Because I've been watching you closely enough to want to be your lover, Momiji.」

name: Momiji
message: 「You always jump straight to saying stuff like that. Even though you were so embarrassed just a minute ago.」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, consider it payback.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Mmph.」
Blushing and pouting, Momiji started getting ready for special training.

name: Iori
message: 「—All right, let's call it a day！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Haaah... It's finally over...」
When I said that, Momiji let out a big sigh and slumped down.
And then, shooting me a flat glare as I walked over saying, "Good work."

name: Momiji
message: 「You said we'd go little by little, and that wasn't a little at all？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, no, that was just a little. By Tenju Special Forces standards, anyway！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Whoa, that's so unfair！」

name: Momiji
message: 「You act like you're going to spoil me, then you don't, then I think you're going to spoil me a little, and then you really don't spoil me at all！」

name: Iori
message: 「Heh heh heh. I didn't tell a single lie, though？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Grrr... You demon boyfriend！ You devil boyfriend！ You un-boyfriend！」

name: Iori
message: 「Un-boyfriend！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Anyway！ I'm exhausted, so I'm definitely taking tomorrow off！」

name: Iori
message: 「Your lazy streak is really showing.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Let's keep exhausting stuff like this to once a week！ Oh, and look, you're busy teaching the other students too, right, Sensei？」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, that's true. If other students ask me for instruction, I intend to teach everyone equally.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Right？ So like once a week！ Even once a month is fine！」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, yeah, I get it. Then let's go with every other day or so.」

name: Momiji
message: 「You just slyly shortened it……！」

name: Iori
message: 「I figure this is about the right compromise. Special training is important！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh, whatever, I'm totally exhausted and I want a break—！ If you don't give me a break, I'm not having it！」

name: Iori
message: 「Sudden tantrum, huh.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Also I want a reward.」

name: Iori
message: 「So selfish！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I want a reward every time I work hard. Then I can work hard again. If I don't get one, I won't work hard—」

name: Iori
message: 「Gently threatening me, aren't you.」
Though I wasn't even sure if it counted as a threat.

name: Momiji
message: 「So anyway, I worked hard today, right？ So give me a reward for that♪」
This time she begs for it with a cute smile.
Switching between all sorts of tactics just to get a reward no matter what.

name: Iori
message: 「……Sigh. Can't be helped, I guess. Fine, if you work hard properly, I'll give you a reward.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Awesome！ Just as expected, Sensei, so kind—♪」

name: Iori
message: 「Feels like I'm being danced around on a string. ……Oh, by the way, anything out of proportion to how hard you worked gets rejected！」

name: Momiji
message: 「It's fine, it's fine. I wouldn't ask for anything that expensive anyway.」
……Though I also kind of think, work hard enough to earn something you *can* ask for.

name: Iori
message: 「Well then, what do you want for today？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmm, let's see……」
Momiji tilts her head and thinks for a little while――

name: Momiji
message: 「Ah, in that case…… I think I want to go on a date with Sensei, maybe.」
――It was great that we ended up going on a date with Momiji like that, but when I suddenly realized it, I hadn't even asked where we were going.
So the next morning, when I visited Momiji's room again.

name: Momiji
message: 「Mornin'……」

name: Iori
message: 「I can't even tell if that's ‘good morning’ anymore.」
Just like always, Momiji was lounging around sluggishly on her bed.

name: Iori
message: 「Weren't we supposed to go on a date？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Mmph...... I want to go on a date, though...... 」

name: Iori
message: 「Though？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm tired and don't want to move...... 」

name: Iori
message: 「That tired?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Because Sensei went so hard yesterday, y'know......？ Even though I said just a little, over and over and over...... 」

name: Iori
message: 「Don't phrase it like that!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ahaha. Teasing Sensei makes it easier to wake up, after all.」

name: Iori
message: 「What a troublesome lover I've got.」
Either way, it looked like Momiji had actually woken up.
Still sitting on the bed, she let out a big stretch, and

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, the truth is, it's not just because I'm tired.」

name: Iori
message: 「Is there some other reason you don't want to go？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Wanting to go is true. It's just, I realized after we made the promise...... 」

name: Momiji
message: 「Going outside means, right？ That I become a Suzakuin, doesn't it？」
I thought she already was a Suzakuin even now—before I could answer, it suddenly clicked.

name: Iori
message: 「......Ah, I see. Being seen by people means you have to be in honor-student mode, huh?」

name: Momiji
message: 「That's right. Once you're out in public, you have to act like a Suzakuin...... 」

name: Momiji
message: 「If it comes to that, it won't really feel like a date anymore. And if that's how it is, there's no point going.」

name: Iori
message: 「True enough...... It is a date we've been looking forward to, so it's kind of a bummer if it gets stiff.」

name: Momiji
message: 「So I came up with an idea！」

name: Iori
message: 「Ooh？ What's with the suddenness？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I can't go outside, yet I want to go on a date outside. What comes in handy at a time like that is...... this！」
Saying that, what Momiji pulled out was something like glasses, or sunglasses—

name: Iori
message: 「Is this...... VR goggles？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yep. If we use this, we can stay at home, nobody will spot us, and we can feel like we're on a date outside, right？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Plus this is the latest model！ It’s an awesome gadget that lets you simulate slight tactile sensations—meaning it makes you feel like you’re actually touching something」

name: Iori
message: 「Ooh, that’s amazing！」

name: Momiji
message: 「To take it even further, it sounds like in the future they’re going to feed calculations from inside VR back into haptic devices.」

name: Iori
message: 「……Hmm, so if your clothes get torn in VR, does your real clothes tear too？」

name: Momiji
message: 「You jump straight to dirty thoughts—」

name: Iori
message: 「N-no, that’s not what I meant……！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, maybe it’ll be possible in the future, though even then it’s probably ten-plus years off at best？ Unfortunately, current devices don’t have a feature like that—」

name: Iori
message: 「I told you, I’m not disappointed！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ahaha！ Never mind that, come on, put it on, put it on」

name: Iori
message: 「You were slacking off just a minute ago, and suddenly you’re rushing me.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Since we can go on a date while slacking off, there’s no reason to put it off, right？ If anything, it’s gonna be the ultimate slack-off time.」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, fair enough. You really go all out when it comes to taking it easy.」
Either way, just as Momiji urged, I put on the VR goggles.
――However. Before booting it up, I remembered there was something I needed to ask.

name: Iori
message: 「Come to think of it, a VR date sounds great, but where are we actually gonna go？ Do you have a favorite spot or anything, Momiji？」

name: Momiji
message: 「My favorite spot……care to guess？」

name: Iori
message: 「Home」

name: Momiji
message: 「Bingo！」
I figured as much, though.

name: Momiji
message: 「So, let’s go with home」

name: Iori
message: 「Somewhere else！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Aww. Even though it’s my favorite spot—」

name: Iori
message: 「What’s the point of a VR at-home date when we’re already at home?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Isn’t it funny？」

name: Iori
message: 「That’s a whole different kind of funny！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ahaha！ I guess it can't be helped. Then... oh, I know—somewhere you like, Sensei.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Like, somewhere you'd really want to go if you were on a date with me？」

name: Iori
message: 「Somewhere I want to go with you... Let's see...」
A place to walk side by side with Momiji. Scenery to take in together with her. Picturing that in my mind, I think about where we could go to have a good time.
...Yet after thinking it over, the answer I arrive at turns out to be a cliché one.

name: Iori
message: 「...Anywhere, as long as I'm with you？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Your place, then？」

name: Iori
message: 「That's not what I meant！」

name: Iori
message: 「...Well, I mean, I actually do think we'd have a great time at my place too, though.」

name: Iori
message: 「I guess it'd be better to say that since anywhere is fun as long as I'm with you, I want to go to all kinds of places.」

name: Iori
message: 「I want to visit all sorts of places and make all sorts of memories with you, Momiji.」

name: Momiji
message: 「.........Sensei, you really just come out and say embarrassing things like that out of nowhere, don't you?」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha... It's a little embarrassing for me too, you know. Can't help it when it's how I really feel.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, I suppose that's pretty typical of you, Sensei.」
Blushing and smiling, Momiji put on her own VR goggles as if to hide her embarrassment.

name: Momiji
message: 「Alright then, just as you requested, Sensei, let's go check out all sorts of places.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah. Then to start off... how about somewhere around here？」
Hearts racing over our first date—even if it was in VR—we finally powered on our goggles.
Our destination: every date spot we could possibly think of—！

name: Momiji
message: 「...So, why somewhere this close by？ We're using VR and everything.」

name: Iori
message: 「Purely because of my own lack of imagination...！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, you are you, Sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「Stop giving up on me like that, it's depressing！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hehe. Still, maybe a place like this is actually better to start with？ We don't have to get all worked up here, so we can just relax and enjoy ourselves.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hearing you say that is a huge relief...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well then, shall we just stroll around a bit? Walking together in a place like this is a classic date thing to do, after all.」

name: Iori
message: 「Y-Yeah！ Thinking of it as walking with my girlfriend is bound to change the mood！」

name: Momiji
message: 「And if it doesn't, it's just the same old neighborhood as always, huh？」
Feeling frustrated at her teasing—
In any case, we started walking through the usual shopping area.
Since it's completely recreated in VR, it feels like a familiar place. Even the people passing by seem no different from reality.
We stroll leisurely through it together as a couple.
Side by side, close enough for the backs of our hands to brush against each other...
Sometimes feeling like they actually touched, hurriedly pulling my hand back...

name: Momiji
message: 「...Hey, Sensei？」

name: Iori
message: 「What is it？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Isn't this... making your heart race more than expected？」

name: Iori
message: 「Well... yeah. It really does make you pretty nervous, huh.」
Momiji, who had seemed completely at ease at first, gradually grew quieter as we walked, her gaze wandering.
Does just thinking of it as going on a date with your lover really change things this much?
Partly because it's our first time experiencing something like this in the first place, we're getting weirdly self-conscious around each other.

name: Iori
message: 「It's supposed to be... just a normal shopping area, though.」

name: Momiji
message: 「And doesn't it kind of feel like we're being watched...？」

name: Iori
message: 「Watched？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ah, look, like those passersby over there...！」
She points at them, though of course, the people there are just images generated within VR.
And as if to prove it, the virtual office worker Momiji pointed at walks calmly away.

name: Iori
message: 「...Is there some kind of feature where they recognize us and stare？」

name: Momiji
message: 「No... there's probably nothing like that, and I know that, buuut...」
Well, considering she pointed right at him so blatantly, she obviously understands that this is all just virtual.
Still, even so, Momiji, looking embarrassed all the while.

name: Momiji
message: 「Even though I know that, it's like I can still feel people's eyes on us...？ Like I can't help worrying about our surroundings... since I'm on a date with you, Sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, I get how you feel, and I'm glad you're that conscious of me, though.」
In fact, I'm conscious of Momiji too, so just walking side by side like this makes me feel bashful.
In Momiji's case, though, that feeling seemed to be much stronger than mine—

name: Momiji
message: 「Gasp！ Didn't those high school girls over there just say something like, 'Look, look, that couple over there！'？！」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, nobody's saying that.」
It's just as noisy here as the real shopping area, and while you could probably make out individual conversations if you listened closely, there's no way any of them are talking about us.

name: Momiji
message: 「I just feel like everyone around us is staring super hard and saying stuff like, 'I'm so jealous she has such a handsome boyfriend' or 'I want a boyfriend like him too'...」

name: Iori
message: 「Th-That hallucination is way more embarrassing for me, though.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, in your case, Momiji, whenever you go out in public, you're usually trying to act like a proper Suzakuin.」

name: Iori
message: 「So going on a date in public without that mask probably makes you way more self-conscious than me.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, worrying about whether this is okay might actually be part of it...」
Momiji, still looking embarrassed as she shrugs her shoulders.
Making herself small with her eyes darting around, she leans in a little closer, as if trying to hide behind my back.

name: Iori
message: （...This side of Momiji is cute too.）
I rarely ever get to see her acting this docile.
She was kind of like this when we had sex, too... Maybe Momiji just has a weak spot for being all lovey-dovey like this.

name: Iori
message: 「...All right. Wanna head somewhere with fewer people?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Huh？ Wait... are you sure？」

name: Iori
message: 「It's not like we had to stay here or anything. It's our very first date, and you won't be able to relax like this, right？」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Yeah, thanks.」
Seeing Momiji thank me with a blush like this is both rare and adorable.
Taking my cute girlfriend along, I moved on to another spot.

name: Momiji
message: 「This is... an embankment？」

name: Iori
message: 「I figured we'd go somewhere with fewer people, though I guess this really is a bit too bleak.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, I don't really mind. I wonder if fishermen actually come to places like this.」

name: Iori
message: 「Why don't you give it a try sometime, Momiji？ It seems pretty laid-back, so wouldn't it suit you？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Coming all the way out here is a pain, figuring out what bait to use is a pain, and between rod work, setting the hook, and reeling in, it honestly sounds like way more of a pain than anything.」

name: Iori
message: 「Way more knowledgeable than I expected...！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Isn't this the academy's stadium？」

name: Iori
message: 「Guess there aren't any matches going on, unsurprisingly.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, obviously not. Though if there were, I'd have some mixed feelings about it.」

name: Iori
message: 「Mixed feelings？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Watching it from the stands makes it feel like I either couldn't compete or I already lost, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「I see... Guess I should've put us up on the stage instead.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm already used to that view anyway, so it wouldn't really do much for me either.」

name: Iori
message: 「Next up, the pool！」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Just so you know, there's no feature to change into swimsuits, okay？」

name: Iori
message: 「...Yeah, I figured as much.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Were you hoping there was？」

name: Iori
message: 「Actually, just a little...」

name: Momiji
message: 「At the very least, I'm not planning on letting you see me in one this summer. ...It's still embarrassing.」

name: Iori
message: （She's already shown me much more embarrassing sights than that, though.）

name: Momiji
message: 「Didn't I just tell you there's no feature to change clothes！」

name: Iori
message: 「N-No, look, I just thought a date by the beach might be nice, that's all！」

name: Momiji
message: 「That sounds pretty suspicious... Well, I suppose that kind of date is a thing, maybe？」

name: Iori
message: 「Going out of our way to stroll along the beach in winter could be nice too.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, we don't have to force ourselves to go in the ocean, after all.」

name: Iori
message: 「...Still, I'd kinda like to splash water at each other and stuff. It feels like the kind of fun only couples can really enjoy.」

name: Momiji
message: 「...In winter, or when nobody's around, I'll think about it.」

name: Iori
message: 「We'd probably freeze to death that time of year, though...」
—Just like that, we spent a while visiting all sorts of places.
Even though it was inside VR, it was fun, and just like walking around on a real date, the two of us laughed and got shy with each other.
And just as our date was about to come to an end—

name: Iori
message: 「Whew... Feels like we played around quite a bit. Even though it's still bright out.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, we are in VR, after all. Isn't it probably almost nighttime in reality？」

name: Iori
message: 「So it doesn't sync up... or rather, they intentionally don't let it sync, huh.」
Well, parks at night are dangerous in all sorts of ways... I hear plenty of stories about couples on benches or in the bushes...
Even I can't take her somewhere like that.

name: Iori
message: 「Still... huh, it's already night.」

name: Iori
message: 「It was our first date, so this is what it means to have so much fun you lose track of time.」

name: Momiji
message: 「...You really say embarrassing things like that out of nowhere, Sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「Wasn't it the same for you, Momiji？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Asking me that feels a little unfair, though. ...Well, I feel the same way, I guess.」

name: Iori
message: 「Good. I'm glad you enjoyed it.」

name: Iori
message: 「Then to wrap things up, let's walk around here a little before calling it a day?」

name: Momiji
message: 「In the end, I feel like I made you pick a place with fewer people right up to the end, so I kind of feel a little bad.」
Looking apologetic, Momiji's shoulders slumped.

name: Iori
message: 「Don't say that. It's my first time too, so taking it nice and easy like this puts me at ease.」

name: Momiji
message: 「...You really are kind, Sensei.」
Walking slowly through the park alongside Momiji, who gives a wry smile.
Maybe because it's recreating a park on a holiday, it isn't completely deserted after all, yet there's no noise or bustle at all.
Everyone there is leisurely taking in the park's atmosphere――
Taking it in... they're all couples......

name: Momiji
message: 「...Doesn't it feel like there are a lot of people who look like lovers？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah... Could this be a place where people who think the same way as us gather？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, sure, if you want to take it easy as a couple, a place like this might be it, but...」
Before I know it, whether I look right or left, even if they're sparse, there's nowhere I can't see couples.
They all look so happy, huddling shoulder to shoulder, touching as they laugh quietly together.
Watching that, it kind of makes us self-conscious too, or rather...

name: Momiji
message: 「A little... embarrassing, maybe？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, but we're a couple too, right...？ It's not like it's weird for us to mix in with them...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, that's... true, I guess.」

name: Iori
message: 「So um... for now, let's just enjoy the scenery and stuff.」
So we start walking through the park once more, though...
What my eyes keep landing on isn't the scenery, after all, but the couples gathered here.
Part of it is catching sight of them and feeling self-conscious——and I'm also curious about how other people go on dates.
As I watched with that thought in mind... suddenly, Momiji spoke up as if she'd just noticed something.

name: Momiji
message: 「For some reason, everyone else... isn't holding hands...？」

name: Iori
message: 「Now that you mention it, yeah... Well, we are a couple, after all？」

name: Momiji
message: 「W-Well, yeah... That much is normal, right?」
...Hearing that, I thought about it for a moment and

name: Iori
message: 「...Should we hold hands too？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Huh...！？ W-What are you saying...」

name: Iori
message: 「We're a couple, aren't we？」

name: Iori
message: 「Come to think of it, we haven't really done much that feels like a couple during our dates so far... so I figured if we at least walked holding hands, it might feel a little more like it.」

name: Momiji
message: 「But holding hands in front of other people...」

name: Iori
message: 「In here, it's inside VR anyway—and besides, we've already had sex and everything.」

name: Momiji
message: 「T-That's true, but... when it feels like people are watching, there's a different kind of embarrassment than with sex, or rather...」
Saying that, Momiji blushed and fidgeted, rubbing her hands together.
She looked shy, yet—almost as if she were expecting something too.

name: Iori
message: 「At times like this... I'll just be a little pushy！」
I forcefully took hold of Momiji's hand just like that.

name: Momiji
message: 「Kyaa！？ W-Wait, Sensei...！？」
Momiji seemed surprised, though she didn't resist.
...Even while feeling a strange sensation like I was pouncing on her for sex, I kept holding hands with Momiji, intertwining our fingers.
Then I lifted our joined hands up right in front of Momiji's face and

name: Iori
message: 「There. Does this make us feel like a proper couple, I wonder？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ngh... J-Jeez, Sensei... You always get proactive at the strangest times...」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha. Maybe it's even more like that because Momiji gets embarrassed for the both of us.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh...！ Whose fault do you think that is...」
In fact, the more bashful Momiji acted, the more proactive I somehow felt like I could be.
Even so, Momiji was blushing even while looking displeased, and her cheeks looked slightly softened somehow.

name: Iori
message: 「Well then... there's only a little left, so let's walk like this.」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Okay. Just a little bit, like this...」
That was how we spent the rest of our date time, feeling more conscious of each other as a couple than ever before.
—The next day.
I was thinking about that date.

name: Iori
message: （It was inside VR, yet I could really feel her hand... Well, they did say it had that kind of feature built in）
That sensation still lingers in my palm, making me look down at my own hand over and over.

name: Iori
message: （...Even though we'd already had sex before the date）
And yet, going on a date and holding hands still makes my heart race strangely. It feels like the order is backwards, though—
...No, it's not like sex is at the top and everything else is just an inferior version of it.

name: Iori
message: （Both were firsts, both made me happy, and in the sense of being things lovers do, they're the same）
Well, walking through the dorm with those thoughts in mind—
Where I ended up was, naturally, Momiji's room again.
Morning, and Momiji's room.
Which naturally means the usual sight—

name: Iori
message: 「...Huh, Momiji？」
Just when I thought the usual sight would greet me.
Momiji was wide awake.
Awake—yet still sitting on her bed, staring blankly at her own hand.

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji？ What are you doing？」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Huh, ah, S-Sensei？！ Why are you here？！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Wait, weren't you supposed to be tutoring Setsugekka today...」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, something urgent came up so she couldn't make it. So I figured I'd spend time with you instead, Momiji」

name: Momiji
message: 「O-Oh... is that right？ Well, I'm sure the Kazamine family has a lot going on...」

name: Iori
message: 「Still, it's rare to see you awake in the morning, Momiji」

name: Momiji
message: 「Huh！ Ah... w-well, yeah？ I thought waking up early for once might be a nice way to be considerate」

name: Iori
message: 「Not sure who you're being considerate to, but... does it have something to do with what you were just doing？ You know, staring intently at your hand」

name: Momiji
message: 「Wh—th-that was, um, well...！ It's just, kind of still lingering on my hand, or something...！」

name: Iori
message: 「Lingering？」

name: Momiji
message: 「.........Whaaaaaaaaaa！」

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji？！」
For some reason, Momiji let out a shriek and pulled the bedsheets over herself to hide.

name: Iori
message: 「Hey... what are you doing, Momiji？！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm not budging an inch from here！」

name: Iori
message: 「Why？! I came all this way to see you, so come on out!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Nooo way！ I'm never coming out and I'm not even gonna look at your face, Sensei！」

name: Iori
message: 「Why do you suddenly hate me...？！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I don't hate you, I just hate you！」
I wage a back-and-forth battle over the sheet with Momiji as she shouts things that make no sense.
Momiji is surprisingly skillful, though, and won't let me pull the sheet off her.
—Just then, a brilliant idea strikes me！

name: Iori
message: 「If I can't pull the sheet off... then I'll do this！」
Giving up on peeling it away—I crawl right under the sheet instead！

name: Momiji
message: 「H-Hey, Sensei？！ Why are you coming in here？！」

name: Iori
message: 「I realized that if you won't move, I can just come to you」

name: Momiji
message: 「That's completely wrong！」

name: Iori
message: 「Then are you coming out？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm not coming out！」

name: Iori
message: 「Then I'm not leaving either！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ngggh... So stubborn...！」

name: Iori
message: 「Right back at you. So with that—today we're having a date inside this dark, cramped closed room！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I wouldn't really call this a date...」
The sheet is reasonably large, so there's more than enough room for the two of us to fit inside.
Not enough to move around freely, though, which means we end up so close we're practically touching.

name: Momiji
message: 「W-Wait a second, Sensei, you're way too close... Our arms are touching and everything...」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, we are under a sheet」

name: Momiji
message: 「And it's starting to get ridiculously hot in here...」

name: Iori
message: 「...Well, we are under a sheet」
And it's summer, too.

name: Iori
message: 「It is getting a little stuffy, though... Momiji, aren't you getting out of breath？」

name: Momiji
message: 「We're under a sheet, so of course I am... You look like you're having trouble breathing yourself, Sensei？」

name: Iori
message: 「We're under the sheets and all... Still, maybe there's an upside to this too.」

name: Momiji
message: 「An upside？」

name: Iori
message: 「Because it's cramped and stuffy in here, Momiji's scent is—」

name: Momiji
message: 「Waaaaaaaaaaaaah！」

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, light returns to the world...！」
Momiji practically stood up and threw the sheets off with all her might.
Then, as if taking her frustration out on it, she slapped the sheets down onto the bed with a sharp smack

name: Momiji
message: 「Sensei, even if we're lovers, that's way too perverted！ Trapping us in a cramped, dark space and getting turned on by smelling your sweaty girlfriend！」

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji's the one who holed up in the cramped dark space. Plus, I didn't say I got turned on！」
...Well, it's not wrong that I got a little turned on, though.

name: Momiji
message: 「Fine, whatever. If Sensei's going to act like that, I have a plan of my own！」

name: Iori
message: 「I feel like I didn't really do anything, though.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Come on, put on these VR goggles！ We're going on a date on the field I picked！」

name: Iori
message: 「Like some kind of card fight...！」
All the same, a date is a dream come true, so I obediently took the goggles.

name: Iori
message: 「...By the way, where is the date spot Momiji picked？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Fufufu—that's a surprise until we get there. Better brace yourself！」

name: Iori
message: 「Brace myself for what, I wonder...」
I didn't know, but either way, I put on the goggles and ended up going on another VR date with Momiji today.
And where we arrived was—

name: Iori
message: 「...A pool？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Knowing Sensei, coming to a place like this makes you picture me in a swimsuit and get all worked up, doesn't it？」

name: Iori
message: 「What do you think I am？！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Even yesterday, you went to the pool aiming to see me in a swimsuit, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, I mean, that was different, it wasn't like that—」

name: Momiji
message: 「Look, look, you're picturing it right now, aren't you？ Me in a swimsuit...」
As she said that, Momiji even struck a light pose.

name: Iori
message: 「If you keep saying stuff like that, I might actually start imagining it, or rather...」
And I end up staring intently at Momiji's body without thinking.
Come to think of it, I've seen more than just Momiji in a swimsuit—I've even seen her naked, so it might be easy enough to picture.
Besides, a swimsuit has a different kind of sexy cuteness from being naked...

name: Momiji
message: 「Ngh... w-wait a second, Sensei...！ Don't stare so blatantly and seriously like that...！」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh？！」
Momiji suddenly turned red in the face and spun her back to me as if hiding her body.

name: Momiji
message: 「Geez, really, Sensei is way too perverted...」

name: Iori
message: 「Even though you're the one who brought it up, Momiji.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, that's true, I guess... I just thought you'd panic more...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Anyway, next！ We're going to the next battlefield！」

name: Iori
message: 「What are we fighting?」
And the place we arrived at was a park.
What's more, for some reason, it's night.

name: Iori
message: 「Well, since it's VR, you can probably set the time freely, but... why night？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Fufu, don't play dumb...」
While giving off a somewhat bewitching air, Momiji pressed her body closer to mine.
Looking up at me from below, she stuck out the tip of her tongue a little and licked her lips...

name: Momiji
message: 「When you say a park at night for lovers, isn't it obvious...？」

name: Iori
message: 「...Well, when you put it like that, I can picture it, though...」
In fact, looking around inside the park, there are even couples hugging more than necessary on benches.
If I strain my ears, I might even hear ragged breathing.
Even without that, Momiji right in front of me has red cheeks and is letting out breaths looking somewhat nervous...

name: Iori
message: 「...Could it be that you have an outdoor exhibitionism kink, Momiji？！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Wha—?！ N-no way... there's no way I have a kink like that！」

name: Iori
message: 「Is that right？ If it's Momiji's kink, I won't judge it—in fact, I'll even work hard to think of ways we can do it without getting caught.」

name: Momiji
message: 「That's why！ Not me—I'm saying Sensei is going to end up wanting to do that kind of thing！」

name: Iori
message: 「...In other words, you're turning me on because you want to do it in a place like this？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Not like thaaat！」
For some reason, Momiji clutched her head and started looking frustrated.

name: Iori
message: 「Uhm... what's going on with you anyway since a little while ago？ Suddenly doing nothing but things out of character for Momiji」

name: Momiji
message: 「I-It's not like... I'm just like usual, okay？ Just kind of, y'know, trying going somewhere different from a normal date, that sort of thing...」

name: Iori
message: 「A date different from usual... I see. True, that kind of thing might be nice too」

name: Iori
message: 「Then next, can we go somewhere I want to go？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Somewhere Sensei wants to go？ Well... I don't really mind, though」

name: Iori
message: 「Thanks. Then... how about right here？」
And so what I chose was――

name: Momiji
message: 「Here is...」

name: Iori
message: 「In short, a hotel」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ho—...！？ T-That means...！」
The moment I said that, Momiji turned bright red again and started panicking.

name: Momiji
message: 「Wai-, Sensei...！ So sudden like that... well of course we've already done that kind of thing, and... I gave off that kind of vibe a little while ago, but！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Still, like, it's kind of direct, or rather, wanting that kind of thing all of a sudden from an attitude like you had nothing in mind is kind of unfair, or like...！」

name: Iori
message: 「M-Momiji, calm down！ What's wrong？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Because Sensei brought me into a hotel...」

name: Momiji
message: 「I mean, if you say hotel on a date, then after this, of course...」
Looking shy and demurely fidgeting her body, Momiji.
Seeing her like that... I finally figured it out.
And wondering what to do as I scratched my cheek, I tell her.

name: Iori
message: 「Uhm... sorry, Momiji. I just meant a hotel at a travel destination」

name: Momiji
message: 「Huh...？ A travel destination...」

name: Iori
message: 「As something different from usual, since it's a place I want to go, I thought how about taking it easy at a hotel on a trip...」

name: Iori
message: 「...Momiji？」
Momiji went completely quiet while turning bright red.
And after doing that for a little while...
Suddenly, Momiji's figure vanished.

name: Iori
message: 「Huh, Momiji！？」
Wondering what happened, I hurriedly took off my goggles.
My field of view returned from the hotel to Momiji's actual room.
However, Momiji was nowhere to be seen there either.
......Nowhere to be seen, that is, except...
I found a sheet bunched up in a round mound on the sofa.
I crept closer to it ever so quietly......

name: Iori
message: 「Uh...... Momiji？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm not moving an inch！」

name: Iori
message: 「Again?！」

name: Momiji
message: 「It's all your fault, Sensei！」
Once I somehow managed to drag her out, that was the first thing Momiji said to me.
Even so, having that thrown at me only left me at a loss.

name: Iori
message: 「What did I do wrong......」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well...... you know......」

name: Momiji
message: 「......Haven't you been kind of unfair lately, Sensei？」

name: Iori
message: 「Unfair？ What do you mean？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I mean...... lately, even when I bring up naughty stuff, you don't get flustered at all. On top of that, you turn around and make me embarrassed instead.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, we're already lovers now, and we've even had sex.」

name: Iori
message: 「Besides, you usually look way more embarrassed than I do, Momiji. Seeing that actually helps me calm down a bit, I guess.」

name: Momiji
message: 「That's exactly what I'm saying is unfair！」
After flailing her arms and legs in frustration, Momiji dropped her shoulders as if dejected.

name: Momiji
message: 「That was one of the few tricks I had to tease you, Sensei...... Now I'm losing to you in every single way.」

name: Iori
message: 「Is this about winning and losing？」

name: Momiji
message: 「It's totally about winning and losing.」
Pouting her lips, she began wriggling her body around in discontent again.
She looked kind of like a spoiled child throwing a tantrum, which was cute in its own right, though—
In any case, hearing Momiji say that got me thinking a little.

name: Iori
message: 「For me...... it actually makes me pretty happy, you know.」

name: Iori
message: 「Not making you embarrassed, I mean—being able to understand your feelings well enough to tell when you're embarrassed.」

name: Iori
message: 「......Though I still have a long way to go with everything else.」

name: Momiji
message: 「......There you go again, Sensei......」
When I let out a wry smile, Momiji blushed for some reason.
I still couldn't completely understand how she felt, either, though—

name: Momiji
message: 「...That's exactly what I mean when I say you're unfair...」
Somehow, I could tell she was happy.
—After that, whenever we found free time, we enjoyed going on VR dates.
The two of us would go to all sorts of places, taking in the scenery and the atmosphere.
Of course, that was fun in its own right, and Momiji was enjoying herself too, so it was fine, except—

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji, why don't we try going outside today？」
Just as we were about to have another VR date today, I made that suggestion.
Momiji froze for a moment in the middle of taking out her VR goggles, gave a big blink, and...

name: Momiji
message: 「...Sensei, have you lost your mind？」

name: Iori
message: 「That bad...？！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I mean, I told you before, didn't I？ Going outside means I have to act like a Suzakuin.」

name: Momiji
message: 「You can't really call something that stiff a date, can you？」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course I remember that, though.」

name: Iori
message: 「Still, I figured I'd rather walk side by side with you for real, Momiji, instead of in VR.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I could add a feature where you walk in place to move forward, you know？」

name: Iori
message: 「That's not what I meant！」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm not knocking VR or anything. It's just, look... if you only ever fight Yorishiro-kun, you won't be able to win in a real match, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「You have to face a real opponent right in front of you and feel the parts that go beyond a simulation.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well... I suppose that's true.」

name: Iori
message: 「It's the same thing—I thought I'd really like to try going on a date while feeling the real atmosphere around us.」

name: Iori
message: 「Even if it's not just our imagination, and people really do see us or start gossiping about us.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'd actually rather not do that... It's embarrassing.」

name: Iori
message: 「More than anything, I... I really want to be able to touch you for real, Momiji.」

name: Iori
message: 「Not just a simulated sensation—I want to really touch you and feel that you're right there beside me.」

name: Iori
message: 「Like that feeling from the first time we had sex... I guess.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ngh... Y-You didn't have to go out of your way to bring that up！」

name: Iori
message: 「N-No, sorry, it just slipped out. It's just, for that reason too, I really thought I wanted to go outside and have a real date with you.」

name: Momiji
message: 「…………Like back then, huh…………」
After I persuaded her, Momiji looked embarrassed, yet muttered something under her breath as if lost in thought……

name: Momiji
message: 「…………Wait outside for a bit, Sensei」

name: Iori
message: 「Locking me out……！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「N-o-t！ Jeez…… We're going on a date, aren't we？」

name: Momiji
message: 「……I'll get ready and come right out」

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji…… Thanks！ I'll be waiting！」
Thanking Momiji, whose face had turned red with embarrassment, I headed outside with a light step.
And just like that, we finally stepped out into the outside world！
……Well, that part's fine, except.

name: Iori
message: 「……Momiji？ Why are you wearing those clothes？」
No matter how you looked at her, Momiji was in her familiar academy uniform.
What's more, unlike usual, she looked like she was holding her posture ramrod straight.
I felt like I hadn't seen Momiji like this in a long time……

name: Momiji
message: 「I told you, didn't I？ Outside, I'm a "Suzakuin" through and through. Messing around with a teacher in casual clothes wouldn't be allowed」

name: Momiji
message: 「So right now, Sensei is my attendant. In a way, you're with me as a Suzakuin's bodyguard」

name: Iori
message: 「Then the date is……」

name: Momiji
message: 「Fufu. Of course, this is a date」

name: Momiji
message: 「What I said earlier was strictly on the surface. Meaning, on the outside we're a Suzakuin and her bodyguard, while on the inside it's a date between lovers」

name: Iori
message: 「Meaning…… we're going to sneak around and act lovey-dovey without getting caught」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, something like that. A lover in the guise of a bodyguard, you could say」

name: Momiji
message: 「That way, the Suzakuin name won't be tarnished, and we can still have a date」

name: Iori
message: 「I see…… Still, having a prominent family background really is tough」

name: Momiji
message: 「If you're my lover too, Sensei, I need you to keep that side of things in mind」

name: Iori
message: 「Something to work on going forward, then」
Sharing a small, secret laugh――
Though it had turned into a slightly complicated arrangement, we finally took our first step on a real-world date.
The place we arrived at this way was――the shop area.

name: Momiji
message: 「……Here in the end？」

name: Iori
message: 「I couldn't think of anything else...」
I feel like it was like this back in VR too...

name: Iori
message: 「Besides, if we're actually walking around, we can't really go anywhere too weird.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, true... Unlike VR, we can't travel instantly, and we can't walk around up in the sky or under the sea.」

name: Iori
message: 「We didn't do that in VR either, though.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, in a way, this is our first date, so let's go with the classics.」

name: Momiji
message: 「True. Besides, dressed like this, we won't get teased like we did in VR！」

name: Iori
message: 「...Pretty sure you were just imagining that, though.」
Anyway, the two of us started walking side by side.

name: Momiji
message: 「So, have you decided where we're going or anything？」

name: Iori
message: 「Hmm... Maybe the movie theater, after all？」

name: Momiji
message: 「That's pretty cliché too. We went on so many VR dates, it'd be nice to put some of that experience to use.」

name: Iori
message: 「That experience, huh... For example, Momiji, is there anywhere you want to go？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Huh？ M-Me... Um...」
Asked that, Momiji darted her eyes around restlessly, looking all over the place.

name: Momiji
message: 「...I-Isn't a retro theater actually kind of fresh？！」

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji, let's grow together from here on out, okay?」
At any rate, since it ended up being unanimous, we enjoyed a movie—

name: Iori
message: 「Man, that was pretty fun.」
Filing out of the theater along with the other patrons, I let out a big stretch.
Beside me, Momiji nodded while clutching a pamphlet.

name: Momiji
message: 「It wasn't as bad as I thought. ...Though it really did feel like a retro theater.」

name: Momiji
message: 「4D in this day and age... Forget nostalgic, that stuff is from before I was even born.」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha. Well, that's part of the fun of a place like that. Besides, the story was good, so I ended up enjoying it without even minding.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, that's true. ...I didn't think it'd be such a super sappy romance, though.」

name: Iori
message: 「Not a fan of romance？」

name: Momiji
message: 「It's not that, it's just, how do I put it...」
Momiji glanced up at my face for a split second, then immediately looked away.

name: Iori
message: （Could it be... the movie got to her and she's feeling self-conscious?）
To be honest, the movie had its effect on me too—just being here with Momiji like this made me feel happier than ever.
Still, that made it feel like a fun date in its own right.

name: Momiji
message: 「Anyway！ We're in the way just standing here, so let's hurry and head to the next spot.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, good point. Let's figure out what to do next while we walk.」
With that, the two of us started walking side by side through the shopping area again.
Come to think of it, there had been a scene just like this in the movie.
Right in the middle of a bustling downtown street crowded with passersby, the guy took the girl's hand and confessed, "I'll never let you get separated from me again."

name: Iori
